text:
Jordan: Quick flag  opened a cluster of small docs PRs that touch the migration guide, CLI reference, and two SDK snippets. They all target the same merge window. Can we coordinate reviewers so they don't all languish?
Maya: Link? I can take the migration guide one.
Jordan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8571 (migration + cli edits), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8572 (python snippet fix), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8573 (ts snippet + example)
docs-bot: Preview queued: PR #8571, PR #8572, PR #8573. Note: concurrent previews may queue due to limited preview runners.
Liam: Heads up: the preview runners are at capacity this afternoon because of a marketing site deploy. If we need same-day merges, might have to stagger previews or ask infra to bump priority.
Eve: I can review the CLI reference (8571) and confirm the command examples. I have a spare hour at 2pm PT.
Maya: I'll do migration guide (8571) and give feedback on tone + compatibility note.
Riley: I'm on SDK rotation this week; I'll take 8572 (python) and 8573 (ts) unless someone else prefers one.
Jordan: thanks. Two asks: 1) can reviewers mark "review:docs" label so release manager can schedule merges? 2) can we avoid merging all three at once to prevent preview cache thrash?
Maya: I'll add review:docs tag once I start. We should also put a short note in PR description about expected merge window.
Liam: If previews are queued, a useful shortcut is to run local markdown-preview or rebuild a tiny subset with `scripts/preview --files` to sanity-check while waiting for official preview.
Riley: quick note on snippet tests: CI has a flaky test that times out on the TypeScript snippet runner occasionally. If that fails we can re-run just that job instead of closing the PR.
docs-bot: CI flake tracker: job docs/snippet-ts timed out 3x in last 7 days. See run history: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/snippet-ts/history
Eve: Found a minor typo in the CLI example in 8571; pushing a tiny fix.
Jordan: great. Also, who can own merge verification at 16:30 PT? Riley?
Riley: I can verify the SDK snippets and smoke test the examples at 16:30 PT.
Maya: I'll be around for the migration doc merge check. If anything blocks, I'll hold merge and leave a comment.
Liam: I'll coordinate with infra to bump preview priority if we need both previews to finish before the merge window.
Jordan: small process addition proposal: when a PR touches both migration guide and SDK examples, require one docs reviewer + one SDK reviewer before merge. Is that ok?
Eve: +1. helps reduce post-merge rollbacks.
Riley: agreed. Also suggest adding a tiny checklist in the PR template: "check snippet-runner locally" so we reduce flake cycles.
Maya: can we also add a quick note to rotation docs: current SDK on-call is Riley this week, next is Marco. Docs rota: Maya, then Jordan.
Jordan: noted. I'll update the rota doc and drop a comment in #engineering to remind folks about merge windows.
docs-bot: Preview completed for PR #8572 (python snippet) 1004: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/8572
docs-bot: Preview failed for PR #8573 (ts snippet) - timeout on snippet runner.
Riley: re-ran snippet runner locally for 8573, passes here. Requeued the job.
Liam: infra bumped preview priority for docs PRs. 8573 job restarted.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #8571, PR #8572, PR #8573. Previews green.
Jordan: merging plan: merge 8571 at 16:20 PT, wait 5m, then merge 8572 and 8573 at 16:30 PT staggered. Riley will verify snippets.
Eve: merging 8571 now.
docs-bot: PR #8571 merged by Eve. Deployed preview to production staging.
Riley: verified python snippet output and ts example in staging. smoke tests ok.
Maya: migration guide note looks good in prod staging.
Jordan: merging 8572 now.
docs-bot: PR #8572 merged.
Jordan: merging 8573 in 2 minutes.
docs-bot: PR #8573 merged.
Liam: thanks everyone. I'll add a short postmortem note in the rotation doc: preview runner limits caused small delay; infra helped fast.
Riley: leaving a follow-up issue to add the checklist to the PR template: #8600.
Maya: thanks. closing the reviewer gap for this cluster. :tada:
